verifiedBy: wrapper (codex ラッパー・ラッパー自身の実測。codex の自己申告は根拠にしていない)

package.note: electron-builder --dir, macOS arm64, ad-hoc Developer ID signing, notarize skipped (local verification)

createProjectDevMode.method: plain node, extension lib/node compiled output, cwd=apps/shell so the repo-root skills/ candidate resolves

createProjectPackagedApp.method: ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1, packaged .app executable, required akari-project-service.js directly out of app.asar (node_modules/akari-project/lib/node/akari-project-service.js)

manualCopyEquivalence.method: cp -a of the packaged-app-created project to a second directory

plainClaudeSkillDiscovery.binaryUsed: /Users/<user>/.local/bin/claude (real installed CLI, NOT the shell alias — the alias in this environment wraps a teams harness)
plainClaudeSkillDiscovery.invocation: claude -p "OK とだけ返信して" --output-format stream-json --verbose --no-session-persistence (no --plugin-dir, no --append-system-prompt, no --settings)
plainClaudeSkillDiscovery.debugLogLine: Loaded 20 unique skills (20 unconditional, 0 conditional, managed: 0, user: 14, project: 6, additional: 0, legacy commands: 0)

applicationSupportNonCreation.method: moved aside the pre-existing ~/Library/Application Support/@akari-video (created by an earlier, unrelated task's shared-store run), launched the packaged .app with an isolated --user-data-dir, waited for the frontend to reach the 'ready' state (confirmed via app log), checked for recreation, then terminated and restored the moved-aside directory to its original location

sourceGrep.command: grep -rn "shared-store|sharedStoreRoot|syncSharedStore|AKARI_HARNESS_PROMPT|SHARED_PLUGIN_NAME|plugin-dir|append-system-prompt|akari-video:|Application Support|@akari-video" apps/shell/extensions --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx --include=*.mjs (excluding lib/ build output)
